Struct Rect

Represents a rectangle defined by its top-left corner, width, and height, with various geometric and utility operations.

public (bool outOfBounds, Vector2 newPos) BoundsWrapAround(Circle boundingCircle)

Parameters

boundingCircle Circle

The circle to check and wrap around the rectangle bounds.

(bool outOfBounds, Vector2 newPos)

A tuple containing a boolean indicating if the circle was out of bounds and the new position for the circle.

If the circle's center plus or minus its radius exceeds the rectangle's bounds, its position is wrapped to the opposite side.

GetProgressRect(float, float, float, float, float)

Returns a new rectangle representing a progress bar with margins applied based on the specified progress and directions.

public Rect GetProgressRect(float f, float left = 1, float right = 0, float top = 0, float bottom = 0)

Parameters

f float

The progress value between 0 and 1, where 0 is empty and 1 is full.

left float

The fraction of progress that reduces the left margin (0 to 1).

right float

The fraction of progress that reduces the right margin (0 to 1).

top float

The fraction of progress that reduces the top margin (0 to 1).

bottom float

The fraction of progress that reduces the bottom margin (0 to 1).

Returns

Rect

A new Rect with margins applied to represent the progress.

Examples

  • Standard progress bar from left to right: Left: 0, Right: 1, Top: 0, Bottom: 0
  • Progress bar from right to left: Left: 1, Right: 0, Top: 0, Bottom: 0
  • Progress bar bottom to top: Left: 0, Right: 0, Top: 1, Bottom: 0
  • Progress bar top to bottom: Left: 0, Right: 0, Top: 0, Bottom: 1
  • Progress bar from center to left and right: Left: 0.5f, Right: 0.5f, Top: 0, Bottom: 0

Remarks

This method is useful for creating progress bars in various directions, such as left-to-right, right-to-left, bottom-to-top, or center-outward. The margin values determine which sides of the rectangle are affected by the progress.
